load_auto_pipeline_text2image: load a text-to-image diffusion pipeline from a pretrained model using AutoPipelineForText2Image.from_pretrained
convert_pipeline_to_text2image: convert an existing diffusion pipeline to a text-to-image pipeline using AutoPipelineForText2Image.from_pipe
load_auto_pipeline_image2image: load an image-to-image diffusion pipeline from a pretrained model using AutoPipelineForImage2Image.from_pretrained
convert_pipeline_to_image2image: convert an existing diffusion pipeline to an image-to-image pipeline using AutoPipelineForImage2Image.from_pipe
load_auto_pipeline_inpainting: load an inpainting diffusion pipeline from a pretrained model using AutoPipelineForInpainting.from_pretrained
